about_the_game:
When monsters invade, the giant robot Super Supreme powers up. It’s your job as a scientist to pilot it into battle. Dream Team Supreme combines strategy, discovery, and collaboration in a roguelike deckbuilding game. Defeat monsters in battle, collect more data about their origins and stop them once and for all.

Program your giant robot for battle

Super Supreme is armed with a predictive drive that displays the monster’s intentions. Plug your cartridges into the beat sequence, Lock In, and Super Supreme will execute the turn. Playing cartridges is free, it’s the order that determines whether you’re the hero standing tall as a skyscraper or you’ve got a monster-sized footprint on your chest.

Play and build 2 decks together

Assemble your dream team! It takes 2 scientists to pilot Super Supreme. Each has their own play styles, strengths, and field of studies. There are 10 pairs to start defending the world with and an unreasonable amount of final deck builds. Will you adapt your strategies to take down the monsters?

Discover a cast of memorable monsters

Saturday morning cartoon monsters are coming through! Monsters are made from inanimate objects! Monsters are mutated creatures! Monsters are Kaiju! Our heroes are scientists who make piloting Super Supreme feel like taking your favorite toy outside for an adventure in the sun. An adventure with monsters along the way.

Explore crunchy new mechanics

Super Supreme and the monsters you face convert any unused block into momentum, a resource used to power up the next turn’s first attack. Momentum makes the giants feel very heavy indeed and raises the stakes every turn.

Fill in the beat sequence with single and dual-sided cartridges. The options are boundless.

1P or 2P co-op

Two heads are better than one, even when they are both on the same giant robot! Talk through problems and ideas with a friend. Celebrations are more enjoyable and it’s funnier when things go wrong.

Endlessly replayable

Every run is different. The map and rewards change every time you start a new run. Dream Team Supreme is all about discovering new strategies by experimenting with different pairings, trying out new cartridges, and installing powerful mods. Content unlocks as you progress and exponentially increases the number of combos you can play.

Just like the scientists that make up Dream Team Supreme, we believe in a strong feedback loop, we believe in testing our hypotheses. We release frequent updates that add features or content. That’s why we organize playtests and seek your feedback. Join the community on Discord to learn the what and when of updates and add your voice to our game development journey.

name: Dream Team Supreme
short_description: Monsters are invading the world! It's up to your team of scientists to pilot your giant robot and save the day. Strategize your way through monster battles, discover cartridges to control your robot, modify it and your deck, collaborate on strategic combinations, and put an end to the invasion.
